newsitem.title: USA: Biospherics to create subsidiary out of ISD.
newsitem.headline: Biospherics to create subsidiary out of ISD.

text.p: Biospherics Inc said Thursday that it will convert its Information and Services Division into a wholly-owned subsidiary. It will continue all current ISD business, the company said, and will feature an expansion of its healthcare business into demand management.

Under the reogranization, ISD, which to date has funded all the company's nonfattening sugar development costs, will be free to concentrate on opportunities in its primary field, healthcare, said Biospherics.

The company added that with the recent worldwide licensing of it nonfattening sugar product to a Danish company, it has received funds that, together with anticipated royalties, will allow it to continue to develop other biotechnology products.
The company said the plan will be presented to shareholders at its annual meeting, May 7, and details of the reorganization will be announced shortly.
